hypothesis: Positive HS300 realized skewness over the last 60 trading days indicates upside-tail dominance and a less crash-prone market regime. Allowing defensive quality/cash stock selection only when the market skew factor is positive may improve recent-year returns and drawdown control relative to an always-on matched control.

factor.formula: negative population skewness of 000300.SH daily simple returns over 60 observations; higher is better
factor.direction: higher is better; positive means upside-tail dominance
factor.point_in_time: signal date t uses index returns through close t; stock execution remains T+1 open

control_strategy.purpose: Same universe, scoring, and execution as the candidate; the market-skew gate is disabled but factor availability is required.

execution.universe: historical HS300 membership; monthly snapshots for 2018-2020 and daily snapshots from 2021

samples.recent_12m: last 252 trading-day returns of the stitched 2018-2026 curve
samples.rolling_1y: 252-trading-day rolling compounded return over the stitched 2018-2026 curve

gates.D1: factor coverage within historical HS300 membership over 2018-2026 is at least 90%
gates.D2: first valid value occurs after at least 60 return observations and recent-12m coverage is at least 95%
gates.G1: independent 2018-2020 total return is at least control + 5pp
gates.G2: independent 2018-2020 MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G3: validation 2021-2024 total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G4: full-sample rolling-1y positive rate is at least control
gates.G5: full-sample MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G6: full-sample total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G7: recent 12m total return is positive and recent 12m MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp

decision_rule: All D and G gates must pass. The 60-return window, positive-skew direction, score weights, stock count, holding period, and stop loss are frozen before results; no post-result relaxation is allowed.
known_limitations: Realized skewness can be unstable and sensitive to a few tail observations; no winsorization or alternative window will be introduced after seeing results.
The factor is market-level and is broadcast to stock rows; the candidate and control differ only by the timing gate.
2018-2020 HS300 membership uses monthly snapshots, so intra-month index changes are not modeled.
The factor is research-only until every preregistered gate passes.
